xr::XrBackend	pub trait XrBackend: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn state(&self) -> SessionState; fn poll_events(&mut self) -> Vec<XrEvent>; fn begin_session(&mut self) -> Result<(), XrError>; fn request_exit(&mut self) -> Result<(), XrError>; fn end_session(&mut self) -> Result<(), XrError>; fn wait_frame(&mut self) -> Result<FrameTiming, XrError>; fn begin_frame(&mut self) -> Result<(), XrError>; fn locate_views(&mut self, _: i64) -> Result<[View; 2], XrError>; fn head_sample(&self) -> PoseSample; fn sync_actions(&mut self) -> Result<(), XrError>; fn controller(&self, _: Hand) -> ControllerState; fn apply_haptic(&mut self, _: Hand, _: f32, _: i64) -> Result<(), XrError>; fn end_frame(&mut self, _: &FrameSubmit) -> Result<(), XrError>; .. }

xr::XrError	pub enum XrError { InvalidFov { reason: &'static str }, InvalidDepthRange { near: f32, far: f32 }, InvalidIpd { ipd: f32 }, InvalidTransition { from: SessionState, transition: Transition }, NotRunning { call: &'static str, state: SessionState }, FrameOutOfOrder { call: &'static str, phase: FramePhase }, DisplayTimeMismatch { expected: i64, got: i64 }, InvalidHaptic { amplitude: f32 }, Unsupported(&'static str), NoLoader, NoRuntime, ExtensionMissing { name: String }, InstanceFailed { reason: String }, SystemUnavailable, ViewConfigUnsupported { views: u32 }, GpuInteropUnavailable { reason: String }, SessionExists, NoSwapchainFormat, ActionsFrozen { call: &'static str }, ActionUnknown { name: String }, SimulatorOnly { call: &'static str }, UnknownOption { key: String }, InvalidValue { key: String, reason: String }, FormatTooNew { what: &'static str, found: u32, supported: u32 }, RuntimeLost }
